summary: Of class.rs's three parse-level refusals, only 'extra bytes' holds an exact position (where the class ended); it now carries Location::ByteOffset. 'truncated or unparsable' was measured and left without one — its nom offset missed the damaged byte by more than 8 bytes in about half of single-byte mutations.
changes: classfile/src/error.rs: Location::ByteOffset(u32), Display 'at byte offset N'
classfile/tests/test.rs: extra-bytes assertion; size lock 24 -> 32 bytes with reason
verification: cargo test green; mutants (offset=file.len, offset=0, old class.rs) red
